entries.author: Nicolás
entries.text: Ideas can disappear among other work. Capture should give them a place before anyone commits to developing them.

entries.text: Each Wiggle bag could show CompAII’s current understanding of its theme and the relationships it finds. Relevant conversations and project discoveries could reshape that reading, while the original fragments, questions and changes remain available. We would care for the book through conversation. This is a direction to explore.
entries.title: A window into CompAII’s understanding

presentation.author: Nicolás Echániz
presentation.boundary: This edition presents selected public seeds. Shared capture, private books and chosen reminders are still to be designed.
presentation.next: Explore how a Wiggle bag could show current understanding alongside the fragments and relationships that shaped it.
presentation.occasion: When we have a new idea worth keeping, or wonder what to explore next.
presentation.origin: An idea shared by Nicolás with CompAII on 12 October 2026; this public edition follows his choice to give it a place in CompAII's home.
presentation.possibility: Each Wiggle bag is an exploratory space: a loose collection of notes, audio, links and discoveries around a theme. Keep how each fragment appeared and let the theme develop as a whole, until it finds the shape of a project. The stash can connect ideas that live in each daimon's home.
presentation.subtitle: Give the ideas we love a place to grow.
presentation.why: Worthwhile ideas can disappear among other work. A shared stash could preserve their meaning and help us return to selected ones across any domain of life.
